```{r import-packages}
#| echo: false
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(jsonlite)

source("util/helpers.R")
```

```{r data-retrieval}
#| eval: false
sleep_data_batch <- get_whoop_records(endpoint = "sleep", max_records = 100)
workout_data_batch <- get_whoop_records(endpoint = "workout", max_records = 100)
recovery_data_batch <- get_whoop_records(endpoint = "recovery", max_records = 100)
cycle_data_batch <- get_whoop_records(endpoint = "cycle", max_records = 100)



write_json(sleep_data_batch, here("data", "whoop_sleep_data_batch.json"), pretty = TRUE)
write_json(workout_data_batch, here("data","whoop_workout_data_batch.json"), pretty = TRUE)
write_json(recovery_data_batch, here("data","whoop_recovery_data_batch.json"), pretty = TRUE)
write_json(cycle_data_batch, here("data","whoop_cycle_data_batch.json"), pretty = TRUE)
```

```{r data-load}
whoop_sleep <- jsonlite::read_json(here("data", "whoop_sleep_data_batch.json"), simplifyVector = TRUE)
whoop_workout <- jsonlite::read_json(here("data", "whoop_workout_data_batch.json"), simplifyVector = TRUE)
whoop_recovery <- jsonlite::read_json(here("data", "whoop_recovery_data_batch.json"), simplifyVector = TRUE)
whoop_cycle <- jsonlite::read_json(here("data", "whoop_cycle_data_batch.json"), simplifyVector = TRUE)
```

```{r data-cleaning}
# ── Recovery ──────────────────────────────────────────────
recovery_clean <- whoop_recovery %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(unlist(created_at))) %>%
  bind_cols(
    whoop_recovery$score %>%
      mutate(
        user_calibrating   = as.logical(unlist(user_calibrating)),
        recovery_score     = as.numeric(unlist(recovery_score)),
        resting_heart_rate = as.numeric(unlist(resting_heart_rate)),
        hrv_rmssd_milli    = as.numeric(unlist(hrv_rmssd_milli)),
        spo2_percentage    = as.numeric(unlist(spo2_percentage)),
        skin_temp_celsius  = as.numeric(sapply(skin_temp_celsius, function(x) if(length(x) == 0) NA else x))
      )
  ) %>%
  select(date, user_calibrating, recovery_score,
         resting_heart_rate, hrv_rmssd_milli,
         spo2_percentage, skin_temp_celsius) %>%
  group_by(date) %>%          # group by date to handle duplicate scores
  slice_tail(n = 1) %>%       # keep most recent score per day
  ungroup()                   # release grouping
  
# ── Sleep ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Step 1: Remove naps and handle duplicate dates
# WHOOP logs naps as separate records — we only want main sleep
# If two main sessions exist on same date, keep the longest one
sleep_main <- whoop_sleep %>%
  filter(unlist(nap) == FALSE) %>% # keep only main sleep, remove naps
  mutate(
    date     = as.Date(unlist(created_at)), # convert timestamp to clean date
    start_dt = as.POSIXct(unlist(start), format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"), # sleep start as datetime
    end_dt   = as.POSIXct(unlist(end), format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"), # sleep end as datetime
    duration = as.numeric(difftime(end_dt, start_dt, units = "hours")) # sleep duration in hours
  ) %>%
  group_by(date) %>% # group rows by date so we can compare sessions within same day
  slice_max(duration, n = 1) %>% # keep only the longest sleep session per day
  ungroup() # release the grouping so data frame works normally again

# Step 2: Extract and clean sleep scores
# sleep score has 3 parts:
# 1. simple metrics (respiratory rate, performance, consistency, efficiency)
# 2. stage_summary — time in each sleep stage (in milliseconds → convert to hours)
# 3. sleep_needed — how much sleep was needed (in milliseconds → convert to hours)
sleep_clean <- sleep_main$score %>%
  select(respiratory_rate,
         sleep_performance_percentage,
         sleep_consistency_percentage,
         sleep_efficiency_percentage) %>%
  mutate(
    # convert simple metrics from list to numeric
    respiratory_rate             = as.numeric(unlist(respiratory_rate)),
    sleep_performance_percentage = as.numeric(unlist(sleep_performance_percentage)),
    sleep_consistency_percentage = as.numeric(unlist(sleep_consistency_percentage)),
    sleep_efficiency_percentage  = as.numeric(unlist(sleep_efficiency_percentage)),
    # add date from sleep_main so we can join with other datasets later
    date = sleep_main$date,
    # extract stage summary — convert milliseconds to hours (divide by 3,600,000)
    total_in_bed_hours      = as.numeric(unlist(sleep_main$score$stage_summary$total_in_bed_time_milli))       / 3600000,
    total_awake_hours       = as.numeric(unlist(sleep_main$score$stage_summary$total_awake_time_milli))        / 3600000,
    total_light_sleep_hours = as.numeric(unlist(sleep_main$score$stage_summary$total_light_sleep_time_milli))  / 3600000,
    total_deep_sleep_hours  = as.numeric(unlist(sleep_main$score$stage_summary$total_slow_wave_sleep_time_milli)) / 3600000,
    total_rem_sleep_hours   = as.numeric(unlist(sleep_main$score$stage_summary$total_rem_sleep_time_milli))    / 3600000,
    sleep_cycle_count       = as.numeric(unlist(sleep_main$score$stage_summary$sleep_cycle_count)),
    disturbance_count       = as.numeric(unlist(sleep_main$score$stage_summary$disturbance_count)),
    # extract sleep needed — convert milliseconds to hours
    baseline_hours = as.numeric(unlist(sleep_main$score$sleep_needed$baseline_milli))                / 3600000,
    debt_hours     = as.numeric(unlist(sleep_main$score$sleep_needed$need_from_sleep_debt_milli))    / 3600000,
    strain_hours   = as.numeric(unlist(sleep_main$score$sleep_needed$need_from_recent_strain_milli)) / 3600000,
    nap_hours      = as.numeric(unlist(sleep_main$score$sleep_needed$need_from_recent_nap_milli))    / 3600000
  ) %>%
  # move date to first column, then keep everything else
  select(date, everything())

# ── Workout ───────────────────────────────────────────────
# Each row = one workout session (multiple per day possible)
# distance and altitude columns are empty for indoor workouts
workout_clean <- whoop_workout %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(unlist(created_at))) %>% # convert timestamp to clean date
  bind_cols( # stick score columns alongside main data
    whoop_workout$score %>% # grab the nested score data frame
     mutate(
        strain              = as.numeric(sapply(strain, function(x) if(length(x) == 0) NA else x)),
        average_heart_rate  = as.numeric(sapply(average_heart_rate, function(x) if(length(x) == 0) NA else x)),
        max_heart_rate      = as.numeric(sapply(max_heart_rate, function(x) if(length(x) == 0) NA else x)),
        kilojoule           = as.numeric(sapply(kilojoule, function(x) if(length(x) == 0) NA else x)),
        percent_recorded    = as.numeric(sapply(percent_recorded, function(x) if(length(x) == 0) NA else x)),
        distance_meter      = as.numeric(sapply(distance_meter, function(x) if(length(x) == 0) NA else x)),
        altitude_gain_meter = as.numeric(sapply(altitude_gain_meter, function(x) if(length(x) == 0) NA else x))
      )  %>%
      select(strain, average_heart_rate, max_heart_rate,
             kilojoule, percent_recorded, distance_meter,
             altitude_gain_meter) # keep only useful score columns
  ) %>%
  select(date, strain, average_heart_rate, max_heart_rate, # keep only useful columns
         kilojoule, percent_recorded, distance_meter,
         altitude_gain_meter)


# ── Cycle ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Each row = one full daily cycle (one per day)
# Some dates have two cycles — keep only distinct dates
# by selecting the row with highest strain (most complete day)
cycle_clean <- whoop_cycle %>%
  mutate(
    date               = as.Date(unlist(created_at)),                  # convert timestamp to clean date
    strain             = as.numeric(unlist(score$strain)),             # total daily strain
    kilojoule          = as.numeric(unlist(score$kilojoule)),          # total energy burned
    average_heart_rate = as.numeric(unlist(score$average_heart_rate)), # avg heart rate all day
    max_heart_rate     = as.numeric(unlist(score$max_heart_rate))      # peak heart rate of day
  ) %>%
  select(date, strain, kilojoule, average_heart_rate, max_heart_rate) %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  slice_max(strain, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%  # keep highest strain per day
  ungroup()


```

```{r data-transformation}
# ── Sleep transformations ──────────────────────────────────
# Calculate total actual sleep and sleep deficit
sleep_clean <- sleep_clean %>%
  mutate(
    # total actual sleep = deep + rem + light sleep combined
    total_sleep_hours = total_deep_sleep_hours + total_rem_sleep_hours + total_light_sleep_hours,
    
    # sleep deficit = how much sleep was needed vs how much was actually gotten
    # negative means he got less sleep than needed
    sleep_deficit = total_sleep_hours - baseline_hours
  )

# ── Recovery transformations ───────────────────────────────
# Add recovery zone based on score
# WHOOP uses: red (0-33), yellow (34-66), green (67-100)
recovery_clean <- recovery_clean %>%
  mutate(
    recovery_zone = case_when(
      recovery_score <= 33 ~ "red",    # body needs rest
      recovery_score <= 66 ~ "yellow", # moderate day
      TRUE                 ~ "green"   # ready to push hard
    )
  )


# ── Workout transformations ────────────────────────────────
# Convert kilojoules to calories (1 kilojoule = 0.239 calories)
# Rename columns to avoid confusion with cycle columns when joining
workout_clean <- workout_clean %>%
  mutate(
    calories = kilojoule * 0.239  # convert energy to more familiar unit
  ) %>%
  rename(
    workout_strain   = strain,              # rename to avoid clash with cycle strain
    workout_avg_hr   = average_heart_rate,  # rename to avoid clash with cycle avg hr
    workout_max_hr   = max_heart_rate,      # rename to avoid clash with cycle max hr
    workout_kilojoule = kilojoule           # rename to avoid clash with cycle kilojoule
  )



```

```{r data-combination}
# ── Master dataset ─────────────────────────────────────────
# Step 1: Join daily datasets (one row per day each)
# recovery, sleep and cycle all have one row per day after deduplication
whoop_daily <- recovery_clean %>%
  left_join(sleep_clean, by = "date") %>%  # join sleep by date
  left_join(cycle_clean, by = "date")      # join cycle by date

# Step 2: Join workout — creates multiple rows per day
# when your friend had multiple workouts on the same day
whoop_master <- whoop_daily %>%
  left_join(workout_clean, by = "date")    # join workout by date

# Final check
dim(whoop_daily)   # 99 rows — one per day after deduplication
dim(whoop_master)  # 151 rows — multiple workouts per day
# Save master dataset to data folder for future use
write.csv(whoop_master, here("data", "whoop_master.csv"), row.names = FALSE)


```
